# xray-rust

> xray-rust is an open-source, embeddable Rust client core for VLESS, REALITY, Vision, TUN, routing, and DNS, with native Apple and Android SDK packages.

## Primary links

- [Core repository](https://github.com/aimalygin/xray-rust): Source, compatibility boundary, benchmark methodology, and core documentation.
- [Mobile SDK repository](https://github.com/aimalygin/xray-rust-mobile): Apple Network Extension and Android VpnService adapters, installation, and release verification.
- [Benchmark results](https://github.com/aimalygin/xray-rust/blob/main/docs/benchmarks/results.md): Reproducible process-level benchmark results and raw output.
- [Releases](https://github.com/aimalygin/xray-rust-mobile/releases): Mobile binary releases and checksums.

## Key facts

- License: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0).
- Language: Rust, with native Apple and Android bindings.
- Protocol path: VLESS, TLS, REALITY, xtls-rprx-vision, UDP, and XUDP.
- Mobile packages: SwiftPM, XCFramework, and Android AAR.
- Platforms: iOS 15+, tvOS 17+, macOS 11+, and Android API 24+.
- Independence: not affiliated with or endorsed by XTLS or Xray-core.
